name: Staff of the Dread Knight
body:
Price 40,530 gp; Aura moderate necromancy; CL 9; Weight 12 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This thick iron staff is topped with a wicked ball of twisted metal. This staff functions as a +1 shocking earthbreaker and also allows the use of the following spells.

cause fear (1 charge)
fear (1 charge)
war song* (2 charges)
feast on fear (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 20,265 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells cause fear, fear, war song, feast on fear
